name: Explain causes of mild bodily sensations
description: Users asked about the causes, normalcy, or physiological mechanisms of specific bodily sensations, minor ailments, and physical phenomena, such as eye irritation, dental issues, digestive sounds, and muscle soreness. The inquiries frequently involved determining if specific experiences were typical or requesting basic information on mitigating mild discomfort for both humans and pets.
